article_path: GameLibrary/技术美术/环境管线/模型导入/验证glTF导入结果时，先区分源数据和目标表示.md

primary_sources.claim: The file API imports data into the supplied GLTFState and returns an Error.
primary_sources.observed_content: API contract distinguishes state population from scene/render completion.
primary_sources.conditions: The article inspects local mesh arrays and enumerates actual objects; no editor import or render guarantee.

primary_sources.claim: ImporterMesh exposes stored surface arrays and generates/caches an ArrayMesh.
primary_sources.observed_content: Repeated get_mesh calls return cached data until cleared; base_mesh can be mutated.
primary_sources.conditions: Fresh state per case; two representations from one import are not independent parsers.

primary_sources.claim: Initial runtime conversion iterates surfaces and passes each primitive, arrays, blend shapes, LODs and flags to ArrayMesh.; get_surface_format exposes stored flags for branch inspection.
primary_sources.observed_content: The decisive conversion is add_surface_from_arrays with surface.flags.
primary_sources.conditions: Pinned source implementation, not authentication of the archived binary.

primary_sources.claim: ArrayMesh creates surface data through RenderingServer and routes surface_get_arrays back through RenderingServer.; surface_get_format exposes actual runtime surface format.
primary_sources.observed_content: The logical array-to-runtime representation boundary is an actual call chain, not inferred from class names.
primary_sources.conditions: No physical GPU layout or actual rendering test is claimed.

primary_sources.claim: Indexed TRIANGLES swap second/third indices, collect used vertices in source order, map complete attribute arrays and remap indices.; primitive flags start with COMPRESS_ATTRIBUTES and are cleared only under explicit conditions.
primary_sources.observed_content: Source shows index validity checks, used bitmap, ordered mapping, position/normal decode with mapping, and reverse mapping of indices.; z-is-approximately-zero condition is distinct from merely planar geometry.
primary_sources.conditions: Only this explicit mapping and face-winding path; no general optimizer equivalence or observed triangle-sequence reordering.

primary_sources.claim: Godot uses clockwise winding for front faces of triangle primitives.
primary_sources.conditions: Source convention and shading normal are distinct; no scene transform is inferred.

primary_sources.claim: AABB size is clamped; non-compressed-flag 3D positions are cast to float and normals are octahedrally encoded and quantized to two uint16 components, then decoded.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read exact branches and corresponding reconstruction. Compression-enabled representation follows a separate path.
primary_sources.conditions: Normal example is explicitly the no-ARRAY_FLAG_COMPRESS_ATTRIBUTES branch; it does not explain the specific old binary or prove a global error bound. No native execution.

primary_sources.claim: Octahedral encoding maps +Z to(0.5,0.5); decoding reconstructs and normalizes the vector.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read encode and decode implementation; uint16 representation of0.5×65535 cannot retain half an integer unit.
primary_sources.conditions: Finite source-based arithmetic, not measured errors or a bound for all directions.

original_method_and_paper_example.role: Editorial synthesis and explicit mathematical reasoning, not a new engine observation.
original_method_and_paper_example.method: Freeze source identity and field-level expectations; compare a known map and winding relation at import, then discrete structure and predeclared numerical requirements at readback; preserve the first divergent stage.
original_method_and_paper_example.paper_example: Five source vertices with source0 unused, complete used-vertex map and two ordered triangles. Exact source-to-target mapping and cross products are derived, not executed in Godot.
original_method_and_paper_example.tolerance: Length and direction are separate contract choices. No default epsilon or all-direction quantization bound is supplied.
original_method_and_paper_example.format_gate: Read both stage formats, test COMPRESS_ATTRIBUTES bit, use requirements for that selected branch; unknown or unsupported conditions remain not accepted. Import option flags and storage format flags are distinct.

historical_evidence.scope: One original four-vertex/two-triangle input; preserved first full-runner failure, corrected run and same-input independent repeat. The added unused-vertex paper example was not run.
historical_evidence.claims: Two array stages, exact selected positions and changed winding, observed small normal difference, nonzero AABB thickness, original acceptance threshold and failed extra assertion.
historical_evidence.provenance: Archived installed build is not authenticated to pinned public source. Source mechanism and historical observations are distinct evidence.
historical_evidence.preservation: No original code, inputs, contracts, outputs, failures or historical source gate rewritten; no old raw environment data copied.

excluded: No current engine/native/compiler/GPU/render/performance/editor/DCC/security or cross-platform test. No universal tolerance, arbitrary optimizer equivalence or whole-library acceptance.
